title: In-game text that sounds natural
problem: The owner asked: "do all the in game text summary and fix to sound more natural, summarise first and get my approval to change".
scope: An inventory of every player-facing sentence and label, with proposed rewrites, summarised for the owner (no change before his approval)
After approval: the approved rewrites in the app, with the tests and browser scripts that read them
The same wording in the print kit wherever the printed cards, rules sheet or update pack carry these texts (owner, 2026-11-14)
exclusions: Any rule, number or card effect
The fixed names of things unless the owner chooses to rename them

acceptance.text: The owner has approved the summary of changes
Every changed screen seen by me at 390x844 and 360x640: nothing cut off

approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-14, after editing the picture page (18 rows: 16 his own words, 1 keep, 1 proposal; the other rows left on "Use proposed"): "okay ive edited, reflect the changes in the digital and physical copy".
